svg.title: Geometric partial sums match 1/(1 - x) only on (-1, 1)
svg.desc: The graph of y = 1/(1 - x) from x = -1.6 to 1.6, with a vertical asymptote at x = 1, and three partial sums of 1 + x + x squared + ...: through x squared, through x to the fifth and through x to the tenth. A shaded strip marks -1 < x < 1, where the partial sums close in on the curve. To the left of -1 they swing up and down with growing size; to the right of 1 they climb, while 1/(1 - x) is negative there.

text.tspan: 1 + x + x² + ⋯ = 1/(1 − x) inside (−1, 1) and nowhere else.
Inside the shaded strip the partial sums close in on the curve; outside it they swing or climb away.
